subject: Vendor activation: PO assignment, billing code and SKU sanity check
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@supplify.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor activation: PO request + spend cap question

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for helping us get Supplify live with Redwood. We're ready to complete vendor setup; attached is the SKU/price matrix for our first purchase (supplify_sku_list.xlsx). We filled the onboarding form at the portal but the system requested a PO number to complete activation.

Can you confirm the PO number we should reference? Also, the pricing contact on our side needs to confirm the spend cap you will expose in the portal — currently the onboarding UI only accepts a single spend cap number and our rollout requires a two-line split (implementation services + monthly usage).

If possible we need: 1) a provisional PO to start provisioning; 2) the ability to track two spend buckets under the same activation (one-time services vs recurring usage). Do we need separate PO numbers for that?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we hoped to complete activation by EOD TOMORROW.

Thanks,
Julia Ramos
Head of Operations, Supplify
julia.ramos@supplify.com
+1 415-555-0187

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@supplify.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: PO request + spend cap question

Hi Julia — thanks for the SKU matrix and the question. Short answers up front: we can issue a provisional PO to get provisioning started, and we can represent service vs usage as separate line items under one PO (preferred).

A couple of requests from our side to avoid the exact issue you flagged:
- Please upload the populated onboarding PDF (redwood_onboarding_form.pdf) with your legal billing address and remit-to info.
- In the SKU sheet, add a column that designates: LINE_TYPE = "one-time" or "recurring" so procurement can map spend caps per line group.

Temporary plan I propose: we issue a provisional PO (PO-78932) scoped to the total authorized spend, then procurement will create two ledger line mappings so finance can enforce separate caps for the two line groups. That keeps a single PO on your invoices while preserving internal spend buckets.

I've looped in Priyom (procurement) and Grace (finance) to confirm the ledger mapping process and whether we need a separate PO for services in AP.

Attachments referenced: provisional-po-78932.pdf (draft)

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@supplify.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: PO request + spend cap question

Hi Julia / Mateo — procurement has created ticket PR-2026-11-09-0451 and uploaded the onboarding form to the vendor record. Summary of actions we will take:
1) Issue provisional PO: PO-78932 (status: provisional). That PO will be tied to two internal ledger codes: LEDGER-712 (one-time services) and LEDGER-809 (recurring usage).
2) Spend caps: we'll set the portal-facing total cap to $55,000 while the ledger enforces $15,000 for services and $40,000 for usage.
3) Line items: procurement will map the SKU rows to the two ledger buckets. If Supplify updates quantities post-issuance we need email confirmation to adjust mapping.

Action for Supplify: please send an updated SKU sheet with the LINE_TYPE column and confirm the final quantities (we currently have quantities in the sheet that sum higher than the quoted total).

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_form.pdf (attached), provisional-po-78932.pdf (attached)

Priyom Das
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@supplify.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: PO request + spend cap question

Thanks — we appreciate the fast response. We uploaded an updated SKU file but ran into two problems when we checked the portal:

1) The provisional PO shown in the vendor portal is displaying a total cap of $5,500 (probably a units/decimal error) not $55,000. See attached portal_po_screenshot.png.
2) Line-item mapping appears to have combined one of our service SKUs (SV-112) into the usage bucket; if that mapping isn't corrected it will push us over the services cap on first invoice.

Given the portal discrepancy we are blocked from finishing activation. Can procurement correct the displayed cap and force a re-sync to the portal? If not, can we temporarily proceed with provisioned access under an interim token while the PO display is corrected?

We can also accept a second PO for services only if that will speed things up (we prefer to keep a single PO but not at the cost of delayed activation).

Thanks,
Julia

Attachments: portal_po_screenshot.png

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Julia Ramos <julia.ramos@supplify.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: PO request + spend cap question

Julia — good catch on the portal display. Short update and next steps: 

1) Cause: Procurement confirmed it's a units-to-cents ingestion bug in the partner sync job (legacy default assumed cents where our system expects dollars). Priyom is fixing the ingest mapping now; that will flip the portal display to $55,000.
2) Line mapping: Priyom can force the SKU SV-112 into LEDGER-712 (services) now. That will prevent the first invoice from consuming the usage bucket.
3) Temporary access: Grace confirmed we can grant an interim provisioning token so your engineers can start sandboxing (no billing until we clear the PO display). Token TTL: 72 hours.
4) Contingency: if the ingest fix takes longer than 12 hours, procurement will issue a secondary PO for services only (PO-78933) and mark PO-78932 as umbrella for usage. We expect not to need this.

Priyom — can you confirm ETA on the ingest fix and the force re-sync? Rishi / Grace — please confirm the interim token approval and which team will hold the invoicing holdback.

I'll log the status in HS-Contact-21567 and close the procurement ticket once the portal shows the correct cap and line mapping.

Thanks all — we'll follow up as soon as the sync completes.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: provisional-po-78932.pdf (draft), supplify_sku_list.xlsx (latest)
